All backend endpoints (RFQ submission, shipment tracking with telemetry/milestones, tiered wholesale calculator) and frontend interactive features (Product Catalog with search/cert filtering, Custom Blending RFQ with confetti toast, Global Shipping Tracker, Factory Standards lab showcase, Wholesale Calculator, and Global Destinations) are fully functional with 100% test success.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All itsTea B2B export platform flows verified successfully via Pytest and Playwright.
